PHASE.NAME: UPGRADE_5 Git Pre-Commit Verification Hook
PHASE.GOAL: Add git-level pre-commit verification while preserving existing RTK and agent hook commands.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: syn hook install writes a trusted .git/hooks/pre-commit script, backs up foreign hooks, and preserves standard git --no-verify bypass.
The hook reads staged files and runs syn verify --staged only when staged files touch Synapse-tracked extensions.
syn hook status and uninstall report the hook state without interfering with existing syn hook claude, cursor, gemini, copilot, and check processors.

STEPS.step-1: Create hook manager logic for install, uninstall, status, foreign-hook backup, and backup restore.
STEPS.step-2: Add staged-file verification mode backed by git diff --cached and existing verifier profiles.
STEPS.step-3: Route syn hook install, uninstall, and status while keeping existing agent hook processors backward-compatible.
STEPS.step-4: Add syn init tip for pre-commit installation after project bootstrap.
STEPS.step-5: Add temporary git repository tests for install, status, uninstall, backup, and staged verification behavior.

VERIFICATION.CHECK: syn hook install creates an executable .git/hooks/pre-commit in a temporary git repository.
syn hook status reports active, not-installed, and foreign states.
git commit is blocked when staged verification fails and git commit --no-verify bypass succeeds.

RISKS.RISK: The top-level hook command already hosts RTK-style processors; dispatch must remain backward-compatible.
Hooks must not destroy user-owned pre-commit scripts; always back up foreign content before replacement.
